mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-01.title: Growth ÷ days
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-01.body:
Growth: from 3 ft $11\frac12$ in to 4 ft 3 in is $\frac12 + 3 = 3\frac12$ inches.
Days: Sept 28 → 30 is 2 days, then Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31, Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31: $2 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 245$.
Rate: $\frac{7}{2} \div 245 = \frac{7}{490} = \frac{1}{70}$ inch per day.

**Answer: $\frac{1}{70}$ inch per day**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-01.title: Count days backward
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-01.body:
A full year minus the days from May 31 to Sept 28: there are $30 + 31 + 31 + 28 = 120$ days from May 31 to Sept 28, so $365 - 120 = 245$ days from Sept 28 to May 31. Heights in inches: $47.5 \to 51$, a growth of 3.5. $\frac{3.5}{245} = \frac{1}{70}$.

**Answer: $\frac{1}{70}$ inch per day**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-02.title: Growth since May 31
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-02.body:
Average rate: $3\frac12$ in over 245 days (Sept 28 to May 31) $= \frac1{70}$ in/day.
May 31 → Aug 16: $30 + 31 + 16 = 77$ days, growth $\frac{77}{70} = 1\frac1{10}$ in. Height: 4 ft $4\frac1{10}$ in. Needed: $4$ ft $6$ in, so $6 - 4\frac1{10} = 1\frac9{10}$ inches more.

**Answer: $1\frac{9}{10}$ inches**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-02.title: All in inches
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-02.body:
Required height $54$ in. Height Aug 16: $51 + 77 \cdot \frac1{70} = 51 + 1.1 = 52.1$ in. Needed: $54 - 52.1 = 1.9 = 1\frac9{10}$ in.

**Answer: $1\frac{9}{10}$ inches**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-03.title: Step by step
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-03.body:
Rate: $3\frac12$ in over 245 days $= \frac1{70}$ in/day.
Height on Aug 16: $51 + \frac{77}{70} = 52\frac1{10}$ in (77 days after May 31). She still needs $54 - 52\frac1{10} = 1\frac9{10}$ in.
Aug 16 → Sept 7: $15 + 7 = 22$ days, natural growth $\frac{22}{70} = \frac{11}{35}$ in.
Yoga must add $1\frac9{10} - \frac{11}{35} = \frac{133}{70} - \frac{22}{70} = \frac{111}{70} = 1\frac{41}{70}$ in.

**Answer: $1\frac{41}{70}$ inches**

mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-03.title: Directly from May 31
mathcounts-potw-2026-08-17-03.body:
May 31 → Sept 7 is $30 + 31 + 31 + 7 = 99$ days, growth $\frac{99}{70}$ in. She needs $54 - 51 = 3$ in total, so yoga must add $3 - \frac{99}{70} = \frac{111}{70} = 1\frac{41}{70}$ in.

**Answer: $1\frac{41}{70}$ inches**
